# MultiscaleSCP

### Multiscale Systematic Conservation Planning Across Nested H3 Grids

**MultiscaleSCP** is an R package for systematic conservation planning
across nested spatial resolutions, using the H3 hierarchical polygonal
grid system and the `prioritizr` package. It supports the formulation
and optimisation of conservation problems with resolution-specific
features, costs, and management attributes.

## Key features

- **Multiscale planning:** Integrate planning units and conservation
  features across nested H3 resolutions.
- **Overlap-aware optimisation:** Meet conservation targets while
  avoiding double-counting costs and feature representation across
  overlapping planning units.
- **Cross-scale connectivity:** Incorporate connectivity penalties based
  on parent–child relationships.
- **Solution evaluation:** Assess conservation outcomes, costs, and
  planning-unit selection across resolutions.

## Installation

Install the released version from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("MultiscaleSCP")
```

Or install the latest development version from GitHub:

``` r

install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("PJMerlo/MultiscaleSCP")
```

## Getting started

Start with the [Multiscale SCP workflow
vignette](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/articles/MultiscaleSCP_workflow_vignette.html),
which demonstrates the package’s main workflow using a small synthetic
example.

The tutorial covers building H3 hierarchies, loading conservation
features, defining multiscale optimisation problems, solving them, and
evaluating the results.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_multiscale_connectivity_penalties()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/add_multiscale_connectivity_penalties.md)
  : Add multiscale connectivity penalties to a prioritizr problem
- [`add_multiscale_min_set()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/add_multiscale_min_set.md)
  : Add a multiscale minimum-set objective and relative targets
- [`add_multiscale_min_set_objective()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/add_multiscale_min_set_objective.md)
  : Add a multiscale minimum-set objective
- [`add_multiscale_relative_targets()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/add_multiscale_relative_targets.md)
  : Add multiscale relative targets
- [`build_crossscale_index()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/build_crossscale_index.md)
  : Build cross-scale index structures for H3-based SCP workflows
- [`build_h3_maps()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/build_h3_maps.md)
  : Build H3 hierarchy maps for multiscale planning units
- [`build_multiscale_atoms()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/build_multiscale_atoms.md)
  : Build non-overlapping cost atoms for nested planning units
- [`build_multiscale_connectivity_matrix()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/build_multiscale_connectivity_matrix.md)
  : Build a multiscale H3 connectivity matrix
- [`build_multiscale_feature_atoms()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/build_multiscale_feature_atoms.md)
  : Build multiscale feature accounting for nested planning units
- [`build_multiscale_objective_data()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/build_multiscale_objective_data.md)
  : Prepare data for multiscale minimum-set optimization
- [`compute_overlaps_by_resolution()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/compute_overlaps_by_resolution.md)
  : Count cross-resolution overlaps in a selection
- [`compute_pu_scores()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/compute_pu_scores.md)
  : Compute importance scores for planning units
- [`compute_pu_scores_crossscale()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/compute_pu_scores_crossscale.md)
  : Compute cross-scale planning-unit scores by resolution
- [`compute_selection_by_resolution()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/compute_selection_by_resolution.md)
  : Stratified multiscale selection by resolution
- [`compute_selection_by_strata()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/compute_selection_by_strata.md)
  : Stratified multiscale selection by strata and resolution
- [`deduplicate_h3_selections()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/deduplicate_h3_selections.md)
  : Deduplicate multiscale selections across H3 resolutions
- [`eval_exact_raster_coverage()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/eval_exact_raster_coverage.md)
  : Exact feature coverage from rasters and selected PUs
- [`eval_geom_feature_coverage()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/eval_geom_feature_coverage.md)
  : Geometry-based feature coverage evaluation from sf column features
  and selected PUs
- [`eval_multiscale_atom_solution()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/eval_multiscale_atom_solution.md)
  : Evaluate multiscale feature representation
- [`load_multiscale_feature()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/load_multiscale_feature.md)
  : Prepare a conservation feature for multiscale planning
- [`multiscale_feature_cols()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/multiscale_feature_cols.md)
  : Retrieve feature columns for multiscale optimization
- [`summarize_coverage_by_resolution()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/summarize_coverage_by_resolution.md)
  : Cross-scale coverage summary by resolution
- [`summarize_coverage_by_strata()`](https://pjmerlo.github.io/MultiscaleSCP/reference/summarize_coverage_by_strata.md)
  : Cross-scale coverage summary by strata
